Drinks:맥주.title: 워커홀릭 (Workaholic)

Drinks:맥주.title: 아무노래 (Any Song)

Drinks:맥주.translation: bring some bottled beer and a few snacks

Drinks:물.title: 예쁘다 (Pretty U)
Drinks:물.why: SEVENTEEN's Pretty U: nervously drinking water at dawn, a line that comes back three times.

Drinks:물.title: 뚜두뚜두 (DDU-DU DDU-DU)
Drinks:물.translation: a fish that found its water
Drinks:물.why: BLACKPINK's DDU-DU DDU-DU: 물 만난 물고기, a fish in water, the Korean way to say 'in my element'.

Drinks:우유.title: 바나나 알러지 원숭이 (Banana Allergy Monkey)
Drinks:우유.translation: I'm happy because there's banana milk

Drinks:주스.title: 멋쟁이 토마토

Drinks:차.title: 음오아예 (Um Oh Ah Yeh)
Drinks:차.translation: If you have time, want to have a cup of tea?
Drinks:차.why: MAMAMOO's Um Oh Ah Yeh: 차 한잔 할래요?, the classic Korean invitation.

Drinks:차.title: 눈 (Snow)

Drinks:커피.title: 강남스타일 (Gangnam Style)

Drinks:커피.title: 커피프린스 1호점 (Coffee Prince)

Drinks:콜라.title: MIC Drop
Drinks:콜라.translation: We've got a kick, just like cola

Drinks:콜라.title: 싸구려 커피 (Cheap Coffee)
Drinks:콜라.why: Kiha & The Faces' slacker classic: a forgotten can of warm cola.

Family:가족.title: 상어 가족 (Baby Shark)

Family:남동생.title: Dumb Dumb

Family:남자.title: 그 남자 (That Man)
Family:남자.why: Hyun Bin sings the male twin of 그 여자 from Secret Garden: same line, with 남자.

Family:남자.title: 나쁜 남자 (Bad Guy)
Family:남자.why: RAIN's debut hit: the title phrase is the hook he keeps repeating.

Family:누나.title: 내 여자라니까 (Because You're My Woman)
Family:누나.translation: Because you, noona, are my woman
Family:누나.why: The hook of Lee Seung Gi's debut: a younger guy and his 누나 (누난 = 누나는).

Family:누나.title: 밥 잘 사주는 예쁜 누나 (Something in the Rain)
Family:누나.translation: The pretty noona who buys me dinner
Family:누나.why: Son Ye-jin and Jung Hae-in's romance; the title is how he sees her: his 누나.

Family:동생.title: Oh!
Family:동생.translation: Don't think of me as just a little sister
Family:동생.why: In Oh!, she tells her 오빠 to stop seeing her as just a 동생.

Family:동생.title: SPOT!
Family:동생.translation: This one's my little bro, that one's my homie
Family:동생.why: ZICO's party hit with JENNIE: introducing his 동생, his younger bro.

Family:딸.title: 행복 (Happiness)
Family:딸.why: Red Velvet's debut song: a teasing, parent-style aside to a 딸.

Family:부모님.title: 이등병의 편지
Family:부모님.quote: [부모님]께 큰 절하고 대문 밖을 나설 때

Family:부모님.why: Kim Kwang Seok's classic about leaving for military service: the farewell to 부모님.

Family:부모님.title: No More Dream
Family:부모님.translation: Adults and parents push the same old dreams on us
Family:부모님.why: BTS's debut song pushes back at the dreams adults and 부모님 hand down.

Family:아들.title: MIC Drop

Family:아들.title: 양화대교 (Yanghwa BRDG)

Family:아버지.title: 양화대교 (Yanghwa BRDG)
Family:아버지.translation: My father was a taxi driver
Family:아버지.why: Zion.T's best-loved song opens with his father, a night-shift taxi driver.

Family:아버지.title: 아버지 (Father)
Family:아버지.translation: Father, only now do I understand
Family:아버지.why: PSY's song titled 아버지: each chorus starts with the word.

Family:아빠.title: 상어 가족 (Baby Shark)

Family:아빠.title: 아빠! 어디가? (Dad! Where Are We Going?)
Family:아빠.why: MBC's hit variety show: celebrity dads travel with their kids, who call them 아빠.

Family:어머니.title: 어머님께 (To Mother)
Family:어머니.why: g.o.d's legendary 1999 song to his mother opens with these words.

Family:어머니.translation: The phone rings: it's my mother
Family:어머니.why: In Yanghwa BRDG, the grown-up son gets a call from his mother.

Family:언니.title: 나쁜 기집애 (The Baddest Female)
Family:언니.why: CL says who uses the word: women call an older woman 언니.

Family:언니.title: 달라달라 (DALLA DALLA)
Family:언니.translation: The older girls say I'm far from grown up
Family:언니.why: ITZY's debut hit: the 언니들, the older girls, judging the young ones.

Family:엄마.title: 불장난 (PLAYING WITH FIRE)
Family:엄마.translation: Maybe Mom was right after all

Family:엄마.title: 상어 가족 (Baby Shark)
Family:엄마.why: The Korean original of Baby Shark: Mommy Shark is 엄마 상어.

Family:여자.title: 그 여자 (That Woman)
Family:여자.why: The Secret Garden ballad: 여자 is the title and the first line.

Family:여자.title: 내 여자라니까 (Because You're My Woman)
Family:여자.why: Lee Seung Gi's debut hit: 여자 is in the title and in every chorus.

Family:오빠.title: 강남스타일 (Gangnam Style)
Family:오빠.why: PSY's global hit: he calls himself 오빠 (오빤 = 오빠는), the word women use for an older guy.

Family:오빠.title: Oh!
Family:오빠.translation: Oh, oh, oh, oh! I love you, oppa
Family:오빠.why: Girls' Generation's chorus: a girl's love call to her 오빠.

Family:할머니.title: 상어 가족 (Baby Shark)
Family:할머니.why: The Korean original of Baby Shark: Grandma Shark is 할머니 상어.

Family:할머니.title: DOC와 춤을

Family:할아버지.title: 상어 가족 (Baby Shark)

Family:할아버지.title: DOC와 춤을
Family:할아버지.why: DJ DOC's 90s party classic: everyone dances, even grandpa and grandma.

Family:형.title: Rush Hour
Family:형.translation: I just follow my hyung, straight ahead
Family:형.why: Crush's hit with BTS's j-hope: a guy calling an older guy 형.

Food:계란.title: 후라이의 꿈 (FRY's Dream)
Food:계란.why: AKMU's FRY's Dream: lying on warm rice like a lazy fried egg, in the hook.

Food:김치.title: 김치
Food:김치.translation: I love kimchi so, so much
Food:김치.why: Norazo's comic ode to kimchi: the word is the title and the whole chorus.

Food:김치.title: All I Wanna Do
Food:김치.translation: the scent of kimchi has soaked into me
Food:김치.why: Korean-American Jay Park raps that he still smells of kimchi: proudly Korean.

Food:면.title: 어머님께 (To Mother)
Food:면.translation: Mother said she didn't like jajangmyeon
Food:면.why: g.o.d's To Mother, one of K-pop's most quoted lines: 짜장면 ends in 면, noodles.

Food:밥.title: SOLO

Food:밥.translation: What do you do all day? Where are you? Did you eat? Sleep well
Food:밥.why: JENNIE's SOLO: 밥은? (did you eat?), the Korean way of saying 'I care'.

Food:밥.title: 밥 잘 사주는 예쁜 누나 (Something in the Rain)
Food:밥.translation: the pretty older woman who often treats me to a meal
Food:밥.why: The 2018 Son Ye-jin and Jung Hae-in drama on Netflix: the title opens with 밥, a meal.

Food:빵.translation: Kim Takgu, the king of bread-making

Food:생선.title: Oasis
Food:생선.translation: It's like leaving the fish with the cat
Food:생선.why: Crush's Oasis quotes a Korean idiom: never leave the fish with the cat.

Food:아이스크림.title: FANCY
Food:아이스크림.translation: melting like sweet chocolate ice cream

Food:아이스크림.title: Hot Summer
Food:아이스크림.translation: shake off my feet and head to the ice cream shop
Food:아이스크림.why: f(x)'s Hot Summer: a summer anthem with a trip to the ice cream shop.

Food:치즈.title: 치즈인더트랩 (Cheese in the Trap)

Food:치즈.title: 늑대와 미녀 (Wolf)
Food:치즈.translation: I'll gobble you up in one bite, like cheese
Food:치즈.why: EXO's Wolf: the wolf eyes his prey like a bite of cheese.

Fruit:딸기.title: 내 귀에 캔디 (My Ear's Candy)
Fruit:딸기.translation: like a strawberry soaked in sweetness
Fruit:딸기.why: Baek Ji Young's 2009 duet with Taecyeon: lips like a sweet strawberry, sung twice in a row.

Fruit:바나나.title: 바나나 알러지 원숭이 (Banana Allergy Monkey)
Fruit:바나나.translation: I'm a monkey allergic to bananas
Fruit:바나나.why: The chorus, sung again and again: a monkey who loves bananas but is allergic to them.

Fruit:복숭아.title: 빨간 맛 (Red Flavor)

Fruit:복숭아.translation: Peach juice, a sweet and sour mood

Fruit:복숭아.translation: Even an unripe peach tastes sweet
Fruit:복숭아.why: VIXX's Shangri-La, set in a peach-blossom paradise: even unripe peaches are sweet.

Fruit:사과.title: 꺼내 먹어요 (Eat)
Fruit:사과.translation: Take it out and eat it, like a morning apple

Fruit:사과.title: 정이라고 하자
Fruit:사과.why: Big Naughty's 2022 hit: the forbidden apple from Eden, as a temptation.

Fruit:체리.title: 팥빙수 (Patbingsu)
Fruit:체리.why: The patbingsu recipe song: shaved ice, red beans, fruit, and cherries on top.

Fruit:포도.title: MIC Drop

heading:계절.title: 다섯 번째 계절 (SSFWL)
heading:계절.translation: I can see a fifth season
heading:계절.why: OH MY GIRL's 'SSFWL' (The Fifth Season): love as a season of its own.

heading:계절.title: 사계 (Four Seasons)
heading:계절.why: From TAEYEON's 'Four Seasons', a song built on the turning seasons.

heading:과일.title: 팥빙수 (Patbingsu)
heading:과일.why: The patbingsu recipe song: drain the fruit cocktail and keep only the fruit.

heading:색깔.title: 불장난 (PLAYING WITH FIRE)
heading:색깔.translation: The color of my heart is black
heading:색깔.why: A short, punchy line from BLACKPINK's 'Playing with Fire'.

heading:색깔.title: 빨간 맛 (Red Flavor)
heading:색깔.translation: The color of your love, redder than the sun
heading:색깔.why: From Red Velvet's 'Red Flavor', a song full of colors.

heading:시간.title: 시간을 달려서 (Rough)
heading:시간.translation: If only I could race through time and grow up
heading:시간.why: GFRIEND's 'Rough' (literally 'running through time') sings this in every chorus.

heading:시간.title: 시간을 거슬러 (Back in Time)
heading:시간.translation: Can't I go back in time?
heading:시간.why: The ballad from 'The Moon Embracing the Sun' asks it in every chorus.

heading:영화.title: What is Love?
heading:영화.why: TWICE's What is Love?: love seen only in movies; 드라마 follows on the next line.

heading:영화.title: Alone
heading:영화.why: SISTAR's Alone: after a breakup, eating alone and watching movies alone.

heading:음료.title: Cookie
heading:음료.translation: no drinks, even if you're thirsty
heading:음료.why: NewJeans' debut song Cookie: a hook line heard six times.

heading:음식.title: Love Lee
heading:음식.translation: even if I eat food I don't like
heading:음식.why: AKMU's Love Lee: in love, even food you don't like is fine. 음악 comes one line earlier.

heading:음식.title: 핸드폰 좀 꺼줄래 (Could You Turn Off Your Cell Phone)
heading:음식.translation: Do you eat food with your eyes?
heading:음식.why: BTS tease people who photograph their food instead of eating it.

heading:음악.title: 음악의 신 (God of Music)
heading:음악.translation: If there's a god of music in this world
heading:음악.why: SEVENTEEN's God of Music: the title is the song's first line.

heading:음악.title: 비처럼 음악처럼
heading:음악.translation: When the rain falls and the music plays
heading:음악.why: Kim Hyun-sik's 1986 classic Like Rain, Like Music: 음악 in the title and the first line.

heading:장소.title: 비밀정원 (Secret Garden)
heading:장소.translation: Inside me there's a precious place all my own
heading:장소.why: OH MY GIRL's Secret Garden is that place: a spot of your own inside you.

heading:장소.title: 사랑에 연습이 있었다면 (If There Was Practice in Love)
heading:장소.quote: 내가 널 만난 시간 혹은 그 [장소]
heading:장소.translation: The time I met you, or that place
heading:장소.why: Lim Jae-hyun's chart-climbing ballad replays when and where it all began.

Jobs / Occupations:가수.title: 폰서트 (phonecert)
Jobs / Occupations:가수.translation: I'm the singer, and you're my only audience

Jobs / Occupations:배우.title: 마.피.아. In the morning (Mafia In the morning)
Jobs / Occupations:배우.translation: More of an actor than an actor
Jobs / Occupations:배우.why: ITZY's mafia-game song: she plays her part better than any 배우.

Jobs / Occupations:변호사.title: 이상한 변호사 우영우 (Extraordinary Attorney Woo)
Jobs / Occupations:변호사.why: The 2022 global Netflix hit about a brilliant autistic lawyer; 변호사 is in the title.

Jobs / Occupations:선생님.title: Power Up

Jobs / Occupations:의사.title: Electric Shock

Jobs / Occupations:의사.title: 슬기로운 의사생활 (Hospital Playlist)

Jobs / Occupations:학생.title: 챔피언 (Champion)
Jobs / Occupations:학생.why: PSY's stadium anthem: 학생 is shouted twice, in a line about riot police and students.

Movies:드라마.title: What is Love?

Movies:드라마.title: 썸 (Some)
Movies:드라마.translation: on TV, a drama just like the one I saw yesterday
Movies:드라마.why: SOYOU and Junggigo's Some: a lonely night in front of a rerun-like TV drama.

Music:가요.title: 인기가요 (Inkigayo)
Music:가요.why: SBS's weekly K-pop show since 1991: 인기 popular + 가요 songs. Its old English title was Popular Song.

Music:댄스.title: 연예인 (Entertainer)
Music:댄스.quote: 분위기 띄울 땐 [댄스] 뮤직 한 곡 때리고
Music:댄스.translation: to lift the mood, I play a dance track

Music:락.title: 연예인 (Entertainer)
Music:락.translation: when you want to jump sky-high: rock 'n' roll
Music:락.why: PSY's Entertainer: 락엔롤 is rock 'n' roll, with this card's 락 spelling.

Music:발라드.title: 연예인 (Entertainer)

Music:발라드.translation: to set the mood, I sing a ballad
Music:발라드.why: PSY's Entertainer: a ballad for the mood, right after the dance track.

Music:케이팝.title: 케이팝 데몬 헌터스 (KPop Demon Hunters)

Music:힙합.title: 연예인 (Entertainer)
Music:힙합.translation: when you want to ride the rhythm: hip-hop, hip-hip hip-hop
Music:힙합.why: PSY's Entertainer: hip-hop, hip-hip hip-hop, impossible to miss.

Music:힙합.title: 특 (S-Class)
Music:힙합.translation: I take big, bold hip-hop steps
Music:힙합.why: Stray Kids' S-Class: swaggering hip-hop steps.

Objects:가방.title: 새삥 (New Thing)
Objects:가방.translation: My mom gets a new bag every birthday

Objects:가방.title: 노래 (The Song)
Objects:가방.why: Zion.T skips the predictable gifts, bags first, and gives a song instead.

Objects:돈.title: 고민보다 Go (Go Go)
Objects:돈.translation: I've got no money, but I want to go far away

Objects:돈.translation: Money, money, a world where everything is money
Objects:돈.why: Super Junior's title and hook repeat 돈: a world run on money.

Objects:시계.title: 너랑 나 (You & I)
Objects:시계.translation: I want to hurry the clock along, but

Verbs:씻어요.title: 누구 없소 (NO ONE)
Verbs:씻어요.translation: Even if I wash my eyes and look, I can't find anyone
Verbs:씻어요.why: An idiom in LEE HI's first lines: you “wash your eyes” to look really hard.

Verbs:와요.title: 눈 (Snow)
Verbs:와요.translation: Snow, the snow is coming down
Verbs:와요.why: In Korean snow “comes”: 눈이 와요, the card's exact form, sung over and over.

Verbs:와요.title: 별에서 온 그대 (My Love from the Star)
Verbs:와요.translation: You who came from the stars
Verbs:와요.why: The hit drama about an alien in Seoul: 온 is “came”, from 오다.

Verbs:요리해요.title: 흑백요리사: 요리 계급 전쟁 (Culinary Class Wars)
Verbs:요리해요.translation: Black and White Chef: a cooking class war
Verbs:요리해요.why: Netflix's 2024 cooking-contest hit: 요리, cooking, as in 요리해요.

Verbs:울어요.title: 울고 싶지 않아 (Don't Wanna Cry)
Verbs:울어요.why: SEVENTEEN's title and chorus: I don't wanna cry.

Verbs:울어요.title: 2 Different Tears
Verbs:울어요.translation: I cried because I was sad
Verbs:울어요.why: The hook pairs two kinds of tears: I cried from joy, I cried from sadness.

Verbs:웃어요.title: 좋은 날 (Good Day)
Verbs:웃어요.translation: The tears are coming, but I smile wide
Verbs:웃어요.why: IU's signature song: smiling through tears at its climax.

Verbs:웃어요.title: HAPPY
Verbs:웃어요.translation: I want to smile every day
Verbs:웃어요.why: DAY6's 2024 hit wishes for days that make you smile.

Verbs:일어나요.title: 파이팅 해야지 (Fighting)
Verbs:일어나요.translation: Oh no, I have to get up, it's morning
Verbs:일어나요.why: BSS's office-worker anthem opens with an oversleep: time to get up!

Verbs:일어나요.title: ON
Verbs:일어나요.translation: Even if I fall, I get up again, scream
Verbs:일어나요.why: BTS's ON: fall down, get up again.

Verbs:일해요.title: 쩔어 (Dope)
Verbs:일해요.translation: I worked all night, every day
Verbs:일해요.why: BTS's breakout hit brags about the grind: worked all night while you were clubbing.

Verbs:일해요.title: Power Up
Verbs:일해요.translation: Have fun when you play and when you work
Verbs:일해요.why: Red Velvet's summer song quotes a teacher: enjoy work as much as play.

Verbs:읽어요.title: CHEER UP
Verbs:읽어요.quote: 메시지만 [읽고] 확인 안 하는 건 기본
Verbs:읽어요.translation: Reading his texts but leaving them unopened is basic
Verbs:읽어요.why: TWICE playing hard to get: read his messages, never let him see it.

Verbs:읽어요.title: 주저하는 연인들을 위해 (For Lovers Who Hesitate)
Verbs:읽어요.translation: I'm a heart that's easy to read
Verbs:읽어요.why: JANNABI's retro ballad opens with it: I'm easy to read.

Verbs:자요.title: 자니
Verbs:자요.translation: What are you doing now? Are you asleep? Are you out?
Verbs:자요.why: Named after the classic late-night text 자니?, “are you asleep?”, sung in the hook.

Verbs:좋아해요.title: REALLY REALLY
Verbs:좋아해요.why: WINNER's tropical hit says it outright, again and again: I like you.

Verbs:좋아해요.title: 빨간 맛 (Red Flavor)
Verbs:좋아해요.translation: Let's shout it honestly: I like you
Verbs:좋아해요.why: Red Velvet's summer anthem uses the card's exact form: 좋아해요.

Verbs:줘요.title: Give Love
Verbs:줘요.why: AKMU's Give Love, in its Korean chorus: please give me some love.

Verbs:줘요.title: 소원을 말해봐 (Genie)
Verbs:줘요.translation: I want to give you all my dreams and passion
Verbs:줘요.why: The genie of Genie wants to give you everything.

Verbs:타요.title: 꼬마버스 타요 (Tayo the Little Bus)
Verbs:타요.why: Korea's favorite cartoon bus is named after the verb: 타요, “ride”.

Verbs:타요.title: 풍선 (Balloons)
Verbs:타요.translation: I dreamed a pretty dream of riding a balloon into the sky
Verbs:타요.why: TVXQ's remake of a children's classic: riding a red balloon away.
